incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Smart routing fallback loop detected — sustained spike in 5xx for tool-calling requests (eu-west-1). Auto-escalation to eng-oncall. Incident ID: INC-2164321000.
Arjun (eng-oncall): I'm awake, looking now. Any customer impact numbers?
Jorge (support): ~15 active customers showing degraded responses (timeouts or 422s) since 09:12 UTC. CS reported 3 paid tenants with live traffic.
Nina (sre): Seeing a repeated pattern: requests routed from eu-west-1 -> fallback to eu-central variant -> back to eu-west-1 due to capacity check, causing a loop and an incompatible model chosen for tool_call payloads.
Maya (runtime-eng): Logs show a compatibility matrix mismatch: quantized variant (gptq-4o-8bit) marked as tool_call_supported=false, but routing policy attempted it for tool_call requests when fp16 variant was out of capacity.
Tom (ml-eng): Confirmed. Error from model: "ToolCallNotSupported: variant lacks tool_call interface" followed by downstream 5xx. Example log: ```[2026-03-15T09:13:05Z] req=abcd1234 route=smart-route-eu chosen_variant=gptq-4o-8bit error=ToolCallNotSupported```
Arjun (eng-oncall): Can we hotfix by forcing smart-routing to prefer fp16 variants for any request with tool_call=true?
Maya (runtime-eng): Quick mitigation: disable fallback to quantized variants for tool_call traffic and pin model_variant=fp16-4o in eu-west until matrix fix. Pushing policy change now.
Arjun (eng-oncall): Do it. Add a canary rule first for 10% traffic to avoid blast radius.
Maya (runtime-eng): Applied canary rule (10%) at 09:21 UTC, then rolled to 100% at 09:27 UTC. Commands used:
```yaml
# smart routing override
smart_routing_overrides:
  - match: request.tool_call == true
    action: prefer
    variants: ["fp16-4o"]
    rollout: 100
```
Nina (sre): After rollout error rate back to baseline for tool_call requests in eu-west. Latency slightly higher but no 5xx. Customer report from Jorge: 2/3 impacted tenants now recovered.
Jorge (support): Sam from CS confirmed main tenant A has resumed normal responses; tenant B still had intermittent failures but working now. Sam (cs): remaining edge cases being validated.
Tom (ml-eng): Root cause is a stale compatibility matrix entry where gptq-4o-8bit was incorrectly marked compatible for tool_call in eu region routing rules. It also lacked required context-length metadata causing some long-context requests to fail.
Priya (product): Any data on how many requests were affected by context-length mismatch vs tool_call mismatch? We need to prepare customer comms.
Maya (runtime-eng): Quick telemetry: total impacted requests ~4.3k in the incident window; ~72% failed due to ToolCallNotSupported, ~28% failed due to ContextLengthExceeded for the quantized variant.
Arjun (eng-oncall): Good. Action items: 1) Keep override in place until matrix fixed and validated (Maya). 2) Fix compatibility matrix source of truth (Tom + Maya). 3) Add automated test preventing tool_call=true + variant=quantized in routing policy (Nina + Tom). 4) Post-incident customer summary (Priya + Jorge). 5) Pager duty follow-up and blameless RCA (Arjun).
Tom (ml-eng): I'm preparing a patch to regenerate matrix from model metadata and tests. Will open PR referencing INC-2164321000. ETA 3h for PR, 6h to deploy after review.
Nina (sre): I'll add an alert for oscillating routing decisions (detect loops where route bounce count > 3 within 30s). That should catch regressions.
Sam (cs): I'll draft a customer message noting temporary degradation, root cause (routing/matrix mismatch), mitigation taken, and next steps. Sending to Priya for review.
Arjun (eng-oncall): Handoff to Nina for overnight monitoring at 12:00 UTC. Leaving the channel once on-call notes posted.
Nina (sre): On-call ack. I'll monitor traffic and escalation channels. Placing a temporary runbook entry: "If tool_call 5xx > 2% and loop detected -> re-apply override and escalate to runtime-eng."
Maya (runtime-eng): Follow-up: we also discovered deployment scripts strip a model metadata field (supports_tool_call) when migrating variants between regions; I'm adding a lint check in the deployment pipeline.
Tom (ml-eng): PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/compat-matrix/pulls/437 (includes test vectors and roll forward plan).
Arjun (eng-oncall): Marking incident as mitigated. Root problem is compatibility matrix drift + routing policy permissiveness. We'll keep the policy override until matrix change is fully validated. Closing page but keeping incident channel open for RCA. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2164321000 marked MITIGATED at 09:42 UTC. Pager closed.
